headline: Download models on work networks with custom certificates
changes: Setup now trusts the same certificates as your computer.

headline: Ask how a meeting went
changes: Ask reads the summary and keeps follow-ups on that meeting.
Writing notes after long calls no longer freezes 24 GB Macs.
Install Yogurt on a Mac with Homebrew.

headline: See call names again in Teams on Mac and Windows
changes: Code Integrity on Windows now lets the speech engine run.
Each linked calendar has its own row in Settings.
The stop prompt closes when recording ends.

headline: See where an Ask answer came from
changes: Hover over a highlighted sentence to see its source.
Meet no longer lists chat messages or page text as names.

headline: Turn an audio file into a meeting note
changes: Choose an MP3, M4A or WAV file from your computer.
Set the date and time of the original meeting.
Yogurt transcribes the file into a new note on your computer.

headline: Get a transcript when the graphics card misses speech
changes: On Windows and Linux, Yogurt tests the graphics card first.
If the test finds no speech, the processor takes over.
Delete audio keeps your transcript and meeting notes.

headline: Keep control of recordings you start yourself
changes: If the call releases the mic, your recording keeps going.
After 30 seconds, Yogurt asks whether to keep recording.

headline: Identify Teams speakers on Windows
changes: Yogurt recognizes Teams calls in a browser.
Speaker names come through from the Windows app too.

headline: Open large calendars without freezing
changes: Calendars with years of recurring meetings now load.
On Windows and Linux, stalled transcription can use the CPU.

headline: See the meeting behind an Ask answer
changes: In Ask, select a meeting name to read the quoted passage.
Automatic stop waits about five seconds after a call ends.
The Windows installer is now digitally signed.
If Zoom stops naming speakers, Yogurt checks again.
People lists you with your company using your invite email.

headline: Connect your calendar on Windows and Linux
changes: Add a private calendar link during setup or in Settings.
On Mac, paste your link in Add another calendar.
Multi-language follows speakers who switch languages.

headline: Keep speaker names during a Zoom screen share
changes: On Mac, Yogurt reads names from Zoom’s floating window.
AI apps you enable can read a meeting’s linked calendar event.
AI apps you enable can read attendee names and emails.
Calls during setup no longer trigger a recording reminder.

headline: Find a word in the full transcript
changes: Search highlights matches in the full transcript.
Press Enter to jump to the next match.
Summaries use less memory on Macs with under 28 GB of RAM.
Manage appears only for permissions with a settings page.
Choose Later to keep working when Update ready appears.

headline: Tell Yogurt how to rewrite a summary
changes: In Regenerate summary, ask for a shorter version.
Stop a rewrite to keep your previous summary.
The audio player moves aside when you scroll down.
If the window fails to open, choose Reload to try again.

headline: See where each day starts in the agenda
changes: Each date now sits just above its first meeting.

headline: Choose a language for your summaries
changes: Summary language applies to new summaries and rewrites.
See who spoke in Meet, Teams and Zoom on Windows.
On Mac, Menu bar only hides the Dock icon.
Use your mouse buttons to go back or forward in Yogurt.
Meet controls no longer appear as speaker names.

headline: Suggested folders stay in place
changes: Open the folder list by keyboard to start on Suggested.

headline: Know which microphone is recording
changes: Yogurt tells you when it switches to your system microphone.
If a rewrite fails, Yogurt says it kept your last summary.

headline: Fewer stray names in transcripts
changes: Yogurt removes stray names from the start of transcript lines.

headline: Hear both sides of a Teams call on Windows
changes: Windows captures Teams audio through your sound output.

headline: Recover empty meeting notes
changes: Yogurt rebuilds empty notes from the saved recording.

headline: Fill in missing transcripts from older recordings
changes: On startup, Yogurt checks older recordings for missing text.

headline: Write summaries when graphics memory runs short
changes: Summaries can use your processor if graphics memory is full.

headline: Keep your summary in view during a rewrite
changes: Your previous summary stays visible until the rewrite starts.
A status shows when Yogurt is reading your transcript.

headline: Choose which meetings Ask searches
changes: Pick meetings and folders from one searchable list.
Each answer shows which meetings Ask searched.
While reading, Ask names the closest match.

headline: A quieter place to type a question
changes: The Ask box lights up briefly when you open it.

headline: Pause the recorder preview when it is hidden
changes: The recorder preview pauses behind the main window.

headline: Keep long meetings searchable while recording
changes: The live transcript displays the most recent lines.
Show earlier lines reveals the rest of the recording.
Search still covers the whole transcript.

headline: Get notes from meetings recorded during setup
changes: Saved recordings get a transcript once setup finishes.
You can hide events without a call link from your agenda.

headline: Connect an AI app quietly on Mac
changes: An AI connection can start Yogurt in the background.

headline: Identify Webex speakers from the participant list
changes: Webex speakers keep their names when Yogurt finds a match.
Unlisted speakers no longer get a guessed name.

headline: Less background work in long transcripts
changes: Transcript animations stop once each line has faded in.

headline: Recover from a recording interruption
changes: Yogurt restarts the recorder after an isolated crash.
Webex transcripts use names from the participant list.

headline: Reconnect a microphone that fails to start
changes: On Mac, Yogurt retries a microphone that failed to start.
Your Mac’s microphone can take over if retries fail.

headline: Keep folders in step with the sidebar
changes: Folder rows move with the sidebar when you use the keyboard.
Search results keep one icon per row.

headline: Add attendees from the meeting invitation
changes: People suggests this meeting’s invitees first.
Take notes is available for solo calendar events too.
Use the date arrows to browse events on nearby days.

headline: Resume the notes you already started
changes: Take notes reopens the meeting’s existing note.
Choose New recording to record outside a calendar event.

headline: Jump to a date in your agenda
changes: Type a date in search and choose Go to that day.
The agenda arrows move one day at a time.
Take notes in the title bar starts the current meeting.
You can delete a recording from the player menu.
With reduced motion, note tabs switch instantly.

headline: Choose where to file a meeting
changes: Select a suggested folder to file the meeting.
Ask shows the note’s own title.
On Linux, Yogurt reads names from Zoom Workplace.

headline: Keep call echoes out of transcripts
changes: Echoes no longer appear as separate transcript lines.
Meeting names no longer slip into speaker labels.

headline: Follow AI downloads in the title bar
changes: The title bar shows AI download progress.
You can skip the larger notes download.
On Windows, Manage opens Sound settings for call audio.

headline: Install a waiting update between calls
changes: After a day, a downloaded update offers Restart Yogurt.
The update reminder stays out of calls.
Ask gives each cited meeting its own number.

headline: See new calendar events sooner on Mac
changes: Events added on the web reach the Mac agenda within a minute.
A purple line marks agenda events that have notes.
Zoom speaker names also come from Gallery view.

headline: Place the recorder at any screen edge
changes: Drag the recorder to any edge, open or closed.
Find a meeting by its date or by who attended.
On Mac, switching microphones no longer crashes the recorder.

headline: Organize several meetings at once
changes: Select several meetings to move them to a folder.
Move selected meetings to Trash in one step.
On Linux, transcripts can include names from calls.
Finishing a recording no longer prompts you to record again.

headline: Use a dedicated graphics card for transcription
changes: Transcription prefers a dedicated graphics card if available.

headline: Choose when Yogurt installs updates
changes: You can turn automatic updates off in Settings.
With updates off, quitting skips a downloaded update.
Yogurt opens on Linux desktops that use Wayland.

headline: Follow a summary as it is written
changes: Scroll up to pause as the summary grows.
Choose Latest to return to the newest line.
You can record while the AI download finishes.

headline: Read the live transcript from the recorder
changes: Hover over the recorder to see the live transcript.
Select a folder name on a meeting to open the folder.
Disconnect a calendar in Settings.

headline: Use your own notes to guide the summary
changes: Yogurt uses your typed notes as hints for the summary.
The recorder preview waits for your pointer to settle.
Ask keeps focus in the question box after you send.
